findings.trigger: Existing Codex credential callback supplies valid authorization of another identity or one without comparable identity, with unchanged expected revision. Registered callback at management_resources.rs:2805 reaches persistence at :6923.
findings.impact: Original credential ciphertext is replaced while identity-bearing bindings remain. New enrollment guards do not protect this legacy callback.
findings.minimal_fix: Use the existing old/new identity guard in interactive callback persistence; keep normal refresh semantics distinct.
findings.necessary_validation: foreign/unknown identity returns409; exact original ciphertext, revision, Disabled and bindings unchanged; same identity succeeds; CAS conflict fails

findings.trigger: Exact completed receipt is read, then getConfigVersion/getCredential fails. Also AddAccountDialog.tsx:228–240.
findings.impact: Confirmed saving is dropped and UI reverts to unknown because downstream read is part of receipt success handling.
findings.minimal_fix: Retain confirmed receipt before follow-up reads; failures block connection/application confirmation only.
findings.necessary_validation: completed receipt+follow-up503 retains credential ID and saved fact; no second exchange/import

findings.trigger: Automatic API setup publishes successfully; user closes its result; ProviderDialog.tsx:86 calls rememberPending(active).
findings.impact: Pending draft remains because versionStore.ts:36 ignores active summaries. Dock says current service unchanged; next task rejects the now-active pending ID at configurationTask.ts:46.
findings.minimal_fix: Settle the acknowledged applied version and its matching pending state independently of a review/navigation action.
findings.necessary_validation: auto import→ordinary close→second import succeeds; active context and dock correct

findings.trigger: Selected or tracked draft exists but its priorChanges is empty.
findings.impact: Draft existence disables automatic application despite there being no other pending change. Existing test :36–42 expects this incorrect behavior.
findings.minimal_fix: Base auto-application on actual prior changes, maintaining ownership and publication CAS.
findings.necessary_validation: empty selected/tracked draft auto-applies; nonempty draft still requires complete review

findings.trigger: Device poll result is unknown; user clicks close-and-mark-unconfirmed. KimiDeviceDialog.tsx:161–172 has same branch; OAuthPage.tsx:26–27 unmounts it.
findings.impact: Close drops the exact session/task recovery handle and gives no persistent pending-result notice. It cannot return to that exact retained receipt from this flow.
findings.minimal_fix: Hand off a value-free recovery key and pending notification to an owning task before unmount.
findings.necessary_validation: lost poll→close→return uses original session_id, reads only, no fresh exchange

findings.trigger: API Key becomes unauthorized/revoked/expired; AccountsPage.tsx:147 does not pass material type.
findings.impact: Main account status incorrectly instructs reauthorization instead of replacement of the API Key.
findings.minimal_fix: Carry actual authentication-material classification into the primary status.
findings.necessary_validation: API Key unauthorized→replace Key; OAuth unauthorized→reauthorize

findings.trigger: Successful invocation leaves evidence.data=true; a refetch is pending or errors with retained data.
findings.impact: New-result title still treats retained true as current identity evidence; neighboring retained-receipt branch correctly checks isFetching/isError.
findings.minimal_fix: Apply the same current-evidence guard to the immediate result heading.
findings.necessary_validation: true→refetch pending/error shows historical/pending; no extra Pin

findings.trigger: Reauthorization establishes a new revision, then runtime read fails with retained expired rows.
findings.impact: Old runtime authProblem overrides new authorization and primaryAccountStatus prioritizes it above read failure.
findings.minimal_fix: Do not let an invalid/stale runtime snapshot override the current authorization; retain old observations with time/scope.
findings.necessary_validation: new active revision+old expired rows+read failure retains current auth and pending runtime status

findings.trigger: Responses assistant output contains two ordered output_text parts; its native decoder accepts and preserves them, then caller resubmits that output in same-protocol history.
findings.impact: valid_assistant_tool_history allows subsequent text only for Messages (:958), so next Responses turn is rejected as ToolHistoryUnsupported.
findings.minimal_fix: Permit ordered Responses text parts while retaining tool-history and closed-field validation.
findings.necessary_validation: two-part Responses JSON/SSE output→next input preserves both parts, order and metadata

findings.trigger: Valid deltas are followed by contradictory response.output_text.done / content_part.done / reasoning done events.
findings.impact: These events unconditionally return Ok(()), so contradictory terminal confirmations and fields are ignored.
findings.minimal_fix: Validate closed fields, item/index correlation, legal phase and accumulated-versus-done values.
findings.necessary_validation: contradictory text/reasoning/part confirmations fail; no successful terminal, saved response or WS root

findings.trigger: Two completed native output items arrive in A,B order; final response.output lists B,A.
findings.impact: Terminal check compares BTreeSet IDs; native_output.rs:322 re-emits start order. Conflicting order is silently rewritten.
findings.minimal_fix: Record ordered item IDs/output_index and verify terminal sequence rather than set equality alone.
findings.necessary_validation: reversed final order fails; valid interleaved items preserve ordered output

findings.trigger: First bootstrap read contains ResponseStart plus valid Usage and malformed later frame in one transport chunk.
findings.impact: decoder exposes pending Usage, but begin() errors before returning source; runtime.rs:4857 uses ?, dropping the only Usage carrier before observer attachment. Historical regression emits its first semantic chunk separately.
findings.minimal_fix: Carry already-validated bootstrap Usage on this exact failed Attempt without replay or guessed counters.
findings.necessary_validation: intro+known Usage+bad frame in first read for Chat/Responses/Messages; exact failed Attempt and one complete source-counter ledger record

findings.trigger: Serve restarts after external Master Key rotation with old records and a new active key.
findings.impact: Serve only loads one master-key and fixes its KeyVersion to1. It cannot express the old+active ring that store unit tests manually inject. This is a missing process capability, not merely real-provider evidence.
findings.minimal_fix: Implement versioned external ring loading and explicit active version without embedding secrets or rewriting ownership.
findings.necessary_validation: actual process restart with old+active keys; public old record/compact reads and active-version writes, foreign-owner safety

findings.trigger: New accepted B ADR changes public protocol and persistence boundaries.
findings.impact: ADR lacks mandatory Context/Decision/Consequences/Alternatives/Validation and rollback structure, especially explicit rollback contract.
findings.minimal_fix: Complete required structure with bounded migration/backup rollback and references; preserve substantive decisions.
findings.necessary_validation: static content/link/diff checks; no product tests necessary

heuristic_advisories.detail: Unused deferred-input bool/field and obsolete terminal comments survive deleted Usage narrowing; remove if touched for a related repair.
choice_name duplicates protocol control spellings in protocol_transform.rs:388/843; reuse existing mapping if related change justifies it.
